baseline_facts.fact: Approved source: TRD-20260910-F345F166 revision 2, trd_done, 30 requirements, 60 acceptance criteria, no open questions/assumptions.
The retained audit establishes F1-F6 and explicitly leaves SHACL phase cost undiagnosed; this planning session inspected source code and receipts but did not rerun implementation acceptance.
All four existing root, standards, ontology-semantic and memory-pilot interpreters report Python 3.12.13; their paths remain separate. No runtime was provisioned.
Ontology (90 files), memory (40 files) and initializer (24 files) reusable/installed packages are byte-identical excluding bytecode/cache products.
Template check returned current with 300 managed files from 296 sources, no additions, changes, deletions or conflicts.
Registry contains sys4ai-depot and sys4ai-template-project only. No ordinary product adoption is selected.

baseline_facts.evidence_locator: git status --porcelain=v1 -uall; git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; git rev-parse HEAD

Agent Task status is valid with 21 terminal and zero nonterminal Tasks; no Task was created or activated.

Eight managed plans existed before this operation; none matches this repair objective. The older second-release plan remains draft revision 2 even though release implementation/audit artifacts exist; this plan does not reconcile that separate historical state.

Current installed code confirms excluded nested aggregate failures, selection-only guard/workbench reporting, live-path-only evidence comparison and parents[3] fixture resolution. These are source observations, not newly run repaired behavior.

Preserve all TRD D01-D08 outcomes: measured SHACL cause, full semantic coverage and finite ceilings, scoped readiness, compatible detailed diagnostics, historical/current separation, explicit maintenance, source-owned delivery and honest final claims.
The exact SHACL remedy and evidence/health representation are bounded implementation design tasks; unresolved measured cause is not an unanswered user-scope decision.
Read-only health, validation, lookup and static setup assessment preserve bytes and persistent timestamps, with no install, download, repair, setting toggle or service startup.
Author reusable changes only in their owning depot collections, coordinate the existing Template watcher, then perform exact manifested root adoption through applicable guard/ownership routes.

No direct production mutation as a test; use disposable fixtures for write/interrupt/recovery controls and cleanup only owned processes.

Current guard inspection, complete selected runtime prerequisites and an authorized read-only matched workbench probe agree with the aggregate/exit contract.
Audit-owned service/processes are cleaned up and no session credential is retained.
